about_the_game:
The past never stays buried at Morse Academy. In this demo for Morse Academy, a psychological horror visual novel, you will follow three elite operatives return to the ruins of their childhood boarding school to track a dangerous fugitive. But as shadows creep in and long-buried memories resurface, the real hunt begins.

Demo Key Features:

  • A ~10 Minute Playable Teaser: Step into the first chapters of the mystery, setting the tone for the psychological horror and deep-rooted trauma awaiting in the full game.

  • Atmospheric and Cinematic Horror: Features immersive soundscapes, unsettling visuals, and a tense, unraveling narrative that distorts reality itself.

  • Three Key Characters: Follow Mira, Goran, and Sarka as they navigate towards the decayed school, reliving fractured memories and confronting the horror of their past.

  • Choice-Driven Narrative: Shape the story through your choices, hinting at potential future story paths.

The Shadows Are Waiting. Morse Academy Demo is a taste of a descent into psychological horror, where guilt festers, trust fractures, and the bonds meant to save you may be the ones that destroy you.

content_descriptors.notes: Psychological trauma, emotional distress, references to catastrophic events, blood.
